properties.name: Tashola
properties.popup_body: Welcome to Tashola, where fashion-forward trends meet everyday elegance. Their curated jewellery collections are designed to make every customer feel special, confident, and uniquely themselves. At Tashola, they believe great style should be effortless, expressive, and accessible to all. At their core, Tashola is all about bringing fashion-forward, boutique-style jewellery to everyone, without the high price tag. With a wide mix of designs and price points, they’re here to make standout jewellery inclusive, accessible, and uniquely yours. At Tashola, every piece is thoughtfully handpicked by their founder, with a focus on style, meaning, and individuality. Their commitment to detail ensures each piece stands out and effortlessly elevates your everyday style. Whether your style is bold, minimal, classic, or edgy, they have something just for you.

properties.name: Paul
properties.popup_body:
The Paul French family have been making bread and patisserie with passion since 1889. Paul still bake their bread in the traditional hand-crafted way, using only fresh, natural ingredients.

Start the day with a freshly brewed coffee and a warm croissant straight from the oven. At lunchtime you'll be spoilt for choice with their range of generously and imaginatively filled sandwiches made fresh everyday. All their rustic sandwiches are made from their own bread, so you know they're going to be wonderfully tasty

If you're planning a meeting and need to impress your clients, Paul can arrange a selection of canapes and mini cakes - just the ticket!

Every item in PAULs glorious patisserie range is une petite splendeur and an invitation to be festive. Designed to lift the spirits, every cake, tart or treat is a little celebration in itself. Come and enjoy this little piece of France amid the hustle.

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.name: Indi-go
properties.popup_body: At Indigo Rasoi, we invite you on a culinary journey through the vibrant streets of India. Step into our contemporary and inviting space located in the heart of Canary Wharf, where we blend the essence of Indian street food with a modern twist.

properties.popup_body:
Everyman Canary Wharf is situated in Crossrail Place and features three screens and a capacious stylish statement bar.

A unique experience, Everyman’s aim is to offer individuality with its trademark seating, outstanding customer service and a delicious food. The broad and exciting programme combines carefully chosen new releases alongside a curated film schedule and an array of exclusive live events.

See you there!

properties.popup_body:

Thérapie Clinic has carved a niche, creating an exceptionally strong, recognized brand through the supply of affordable, accessible and most up to date Laser and Aesthetic treatments available globally, such as laser hair removal, anti-wrinkles injections and advanced skin care.

Trust is one of our core values and our aim is to empower our clients, women and men, to become the best possible version of themselves. We want to not just meet your expectations, but to exceed them.

At Thérapie Clinic, we take an integrated approach to beauty, helping our clients discover the best version of themselves.

properties.popup_body: Kung Fu Mama brings the flavours of Taiwan’s night markets to London with a bright and healthy twist. Dishes include noodle bowls such as Chicken with Ginger & Sesame and 12-Hour Beef Noodles, plus their creative baos. The founders Noam Bar and Chris Hsu believe in bringing a contemporary take on Taiwanese flavours, with food that is high-quality and full of flavour.

properties.name: Monica Vinader
properties.popup_body:
One of the fastest growing British jewellery brands, Monica Vinader has taken the accessible luxury jewellery market by storm, successfully bridging the gap between fine and fashion jewellery to gain a strong following across a wide range of customers. Born out of a love of eye-catching, colourful jewellery and inspired by travel, the brand was formed with the desire to create beautiful pieces that can be worn every day.

From iconic friendship bracelets to vibrant gemstones and attainable diamonds, collections are extremely versatile. The brand empowers individuality, encouraging customers to mix, stack and layer pieces to create their own personal styles.

The second Monica Vinader London boutique, the Canary Wharf, Jubilee Place store is designed to reflect the brand's love of materials and provide a joyful shopping experience. With a dedicated in store engraving service, this is the go-to destination for same day, complimentary engraving, providing the ultimate in customisation to add a bespoke finish, or create the perfect gift.

Make it your own: Get your name, message or doodle set in gold with complimentary engraving every Thursday 4-8pm with free champagne and styling advice

properties.name: Ole & Steen
properties.popup_body:
Coming soon to Jubilee Place…

For 10,950 mornings – or 30 years – the pursuit of better ingredients, better craftsmanship and better taste has been what gets Ole & Steen up in the morning. It’s this pursuit that made two Danish bakers wake up with the same vision all those years ago – to create a better bakery for all. Better morning coffee and weekend delights. Better lunches, treats and celebrations. How? By refining simple recipes, experimenting and serving the result in beautiful surroundings.

It’s now been 30 years since it all started in our first Lagkagehuset bakery in Copenhagen, and our first UK bakery opened on 19th December 2016 on Haymarket, under the name “Ole & Steen”. Today more than 300 bakers work to support the Danish, London and New York bakeries. We have a few more bakeries these days and we want even more people to be able to wake up to better bread. So, whether you live in Denmark, London or New York, that’s what gets us up – morning after morning, year after year.

properties.name: Hotel Chocolat
properties.popup_body: Venture into a world of chocolate and find a store brimming with imaginative recipes and wow-worthy gifts carefully crafted by in-house chocolatiers. You’ll also discover their Velvetiser Café, where their team will craft your drinking chocolate just the way you like it: choose from hundreds of combinations of real chocolate recipes, serving styles and toppings and savour them in their seating area. At Hotel Chocolat they’re on a mission to make people and nature happy through chocolate. Everything they craft comes back to their mantra: ‘More Cacao, Less Sugar’. Their passion for cacao led them to purchase their own cacao farm on Saint Lucia over 20 years ago, and they’ve been working alongside fellow farmers to develop and instil gentle farming methods that are kind to both nature and farming families ever since.

properties.name: COS
properties.popup_body:
COS is a fashion brand for women and men who want modern, functional and considered design.

Offering reinvented classics and wardrobe essentials, we create pieces that are made to last beyond the season, merging traditional methods and new techniques to form timeless, understated collections.

Since launching in 2007, we have opened stores worldwide in carefully considered locations, applying an architectural design concept that preserves buildings' original features whilst creating a modern, welcoming space.

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.popup_body: Poke House is the place to be if you want to live the authentic Californian experience with colourful poke bowls, made with fresh and high quality ingredients. The typical wild & healthy lifestyle of the real West Coast.

properties.name: JENKI Matcha
properties.popup_body:
Hi! We're Claudia and Otto Boyer 

We were both wired and jittery, running on too much coffee and not enough calm. Then we discovered matcha.

But finding delicious matcha in the UK? Impossible. So we went to Japan to source the best, meeting the makers, tasting hundreds, and learning what makes matcha truly great.

We brought that discovery home, creating JENKI in 2020 to share the ultimate matcha experience with London and beyond.

Our name comes from genki 元気, the Japanese word for life force, energy, and vitality. That’s what we’re here to spread: clean green energy that lifts you up, not crashes you down.

properties.name: Sostrene Grene
properties.popup_body:
Søstrene Grene makes a virtue of ensuring that you always have what you need for the home, for creative endeavours, and for the bigger and smaller celebrations of life. 

The Danish retail chain, established in 1973, offers a selection of small furniture, homeware, crafting items, and much more. With an ever-changing assortment, you can experience something new at every visit. 

Søstrene Grene not only aims to provide you with a shopping experience but also to lend you a moment to immerse yourself in the serenity of the wonderful world of Anna and Clara, just as they have been doing for the past 50 years. 

Visit the sisters’ wonderful world and experience the delight of the smaller things in life, for it is often those that bring the greatest joy.

properties.name: Barry's
properties.popup_body:
Barry's is Los Angeles' original indoor boutique bootcamp. Based around the simple idea of shocking your body with a combination of strength and cardiovascular exercises, enhanced by a night-club sound system and red lighting, clients often burn over 1,000 calories during a one hour class.

Our workouts include interval cardiovascular routines on Woodway treadmills and strength training utilising free weights. Muscle groups, intervals and workout segments vary to keep you guessing, and our trainers are the best in the business at helping you maximise your potential and ensuring every class feels new, fun and exciting.

Switch the board room for the Red Room and get your colleagues together for a team workout. Drop us an email marketinguk@barrysbootcamp.com to find out more about Sweatworking and corporate rates.

You won't experience a workout like this anywhere else.

Location: Crossrail Place

properties.name: Leon
properties.popup_body:
Food at Leon is naturally full of flavour, full of goodness and comes from people we know and like. Breakfast and lunch is served in boxes and bags from the counter. In the evenings dinner is served on plates at your table. The food is cooked with seasonal ingredients, olive oil, fresh herbs and spices. Coffees, cakes, juices and smoothies are served all day. Beer and wine is sold from lunchtime.

At Leon you can pick up breakfast on your way to work; pop in for lunch; meet up with friends for drinks, dinner or both; or simply take time out for tea on your own. It's up to you.

Find Leon in Cabot Place Canary Wharf

- Poke House is the place to be if you want to live the authentic Californian experience with colourful poke bowls, made with fresh and high quality ingredients. The typical wild & healthy lifestyle of the real West Coast.

- Thunderbird Fried Chicken - Coming soon to Wharf Kitchen…
Back to where it all began – Thunderbird Fried Chicken returns home to Canary Wharf
Thunderbird Fried Chicken serve up the most crave-worthy chicken. Best known for award-winning wings and burgers, their signature Chipuffalo Wings (these babies won WingFest, voted the best Buffalo Wings in London!), the Thunderbun (The OG burger featuring juicy chicken slathered in awesome sauce) and Strips n’ dips by the Bucket load. All chicken is halal and plant based options are also available.

- Biang – Authentic street food from the ancient capital of China - Xi’an including Chinese burgers and hand-pulled ’Biang’ noodles.

- Rainbo – Rainbo was born out of a pure and undying love for gyoza, good times and good food. Our mission is to spread the word... and the word is dumplings...

See individual restaurants for their opening times.

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.name: The Salad Kitchen
properties.popup_body:
The Salad Kitchen was founded by Sam and Ross in 2014. Tired of boring salad bowls stuffed with chopped lettuce, the two lads embarked on a mission to create the most versatile and deliciously indulgent salads on the market… and so, the Crunchbox was born.

Our salads are more than just a side dish. Inspired by the riotous flavours of London’s street food scene, our unique and vibrant recipes are created in house and prepared fresh by our wonderful team. Nutritious, delicious food that just happens to be healthy

properties.name: Rituals…
properties.popup_body:
RITUALS... was founded by Raymond Cloosterman in 2000 and was the first brand in the world to pioneer a combination of luxury home and body cosmetics. They develop high quality products to enrich body and soul: luxury goods ranging from body and facial care, to organic cotton ware, scented candles, perfumes, gemstone make-up and tea.

The RITUALS... philosophy is simple: happiness can be found in the smallest of things. It is their passion to transform everyday routines into meaningful rituals. Just taking the time to enjoy simple things like a warm bath, a cup of tea or a relaxing massage can transform them into meaningful experiences.

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.popup_body: Welcome to Tashola, where fashion-forward trends meet everyday elegance. Their curated jewellery collections are designed to make every customer feel special, confident, and uniquely themselves. At Tashola, they believe great style should be effortless, expressive, and accessible to all. At their core, Tashola is all about bringing fashion-forward, boutique-style jewellery to everyone, without the high price tag. With a wide mix of designs and price points, they’re here to make standout jewellery inclusive, accessible, and uniquely yours. At Tashola, every piece is thoughtfully handpicked by their founder, with a focus on style, meaning, and individuality. Their commitment to detail ensures each piece stands out and effortlessly elevates your everyday style. Whether your style is bold, minimal, classic, or edgy, they have something just for you.
